source_tree.canonicalization: SHA-256 over domain bytes airvortex-source-tree-v1\0, then each file in lexicographic POSIX-relative-path order as uint64_be(path_byte_length), UTF-8 path bytes, uint64_be(content_byte_length), raw content bytes
source_tree.scope: pyproject.toml, top-level run.py/run_gui.sh launchers when present, and regular *.py files below src/airvortex; allow-list excludes outputs, caches, bytecode, tests, documents, and user data

boundary_conditions.bar: impermeable capsule voxel faces + stationary no-slip wall-layer relaxation

contact_angle.law: local geometric equilibrium angle; no forward hysteretic mobility

boundary_conditions.side_and_floor: impermeable voxel faces + local no-slip wall-layer relaxation
boundary_conditions.top_pressure: atmospheric gauge p=0 Dirichlet at half-cell distance
boundary_conditions.top_velocity_and_phase: open advective boundary; incoming material is pure gas stationary in laboratory frame

capabilities.evidence_level: independent numerical reference; quantitative only after frozen grid/time convergence and sealed experiment validation
capabilities.model: HF3D variable-density incompressible one-fluid Navier-Stokes + conservative colour interface + CSF + embedded capsule in a bar-co-rotating frame

coordinate_frame.bar_angle: exact integral of piecewise-linear actual signed rpm
coordinate_frame.reported_velocity_fields: saved r/theta/z averages are laboratory-frame; final full 3D includes both frames

cfl_controller.known_source_bound: positive root of R*dt + A*dt^2 <= target for current/wall advection plus analytic gravity/rotating-frame bounds
cfl_controller.unknown_operator_policy: complete-step post-projection gate with transactional retry

numerical_quality_gate.reason: This run alone has no frozen multi-grid/time convergence or sealed experimental validation.

diagnostics.pressure_solver: variable-density SPD MAC projection with vertical-line block-Jacobi PCG

metadata.evidence_level: NUMERICAL-IMPLEMENTATION-ONLY until frozen refinement and experiment validation
limitations: The cylindrical vessel and capsule are cell-centre voxel geometries; cut-cell fractions and body-fitted boundary layers are not implemented.

The interface is a conservative diffuse colour field with projected colour-gradient CSF, not geometric PLIC VOF; parasitic currents and curvature error require frozen static-drop and refinement tests.
No-slip is an explicitly reported immersed wall-layer relaxation. Its layer thickness and relaxation time are numerical controls and require refinement.
Contact angle is a local equilibrium geometric condition. Dynamic contact-angle hysteresis, microscopic slip and contamination are not resolved.
The prescribed bar trajectory assumes measured actual bar rpm; magnetic torque, motor dynamics, asynchronous slip and bar wobble are outside this backend.
A resolution-gated gas path is a numerical topology observation, not an experimentally validated stable-channel or critical-rpm prediction.
Only saved azimuthal averages and the final full 3D state are archived by the backend; this bounds memory but does not preserve every transient 3D voxel field.
metadata.model: HF3D variable-density incompressible one-fluid Navier-Stokes + conservative colour interface + CSF + embedded capsule in a bar-co-rotating frame

observable_definitions.axisymmetry_error: within-annulus surface-height residual norm divided by resolved mean-deformation norm
observable_definitions.connection_candidate: top-connected gas path whose minimum equivalent cross-section radius passes the interface/grid gate
observable_definitions.funnel_depth_m: outer-annulus mean height minus central minimum height (shared shape observable)
observable_definitions.nominal_central_depression_m: initial nominal liquid height minus central minimum; includes raster-volume offset
observable_definitions.surface_depth_m: outer annulus azimuthal-mean height minus central minimum height
